notes.title: SLH v1.5 Update!
notes.content:
Hey, folks! Thank you for being so patient with me as I work through a bunch of the bugs in the game, but now I finally believe that I've fixed all the bugs that people have brought up!

This should fix the following issues:
-Achievements not registering
-Fanfic bonus not being granted
-Doll bonus not being granted
-Secret password not being accepted
-M.Net Chat can be restarted to beginning of same day
-Egg Friend crashes when setting new record

<3 *~May the warmth of love guide you, Guardians!~* <3

EDIT: Okay I just issued a minor patch to fix a game-breaking bug found in v1.5 - the new version is up, and hopefully that won't be an issue anymore! ...Hopefully. >.>

-Victoria
